# PlanCraftAI

> PlanCraftAI is an AI task planner and personal action assistant that turns scattered thoughts into clear next actions, realistic daily plans, and follow-through.

## Product summary

PlanCraftAI helps people capture tasks by voice or text, understand what matters today, and move from an unclear task to a concrete next step. It combines task planning, focus sessions, reminders, calendar context, and optional Intelligence agents in one workflow.

## Core capabilities

- Voice and natural-language task capture
- AI daily planning around priorities and calendar pressure
- Next-best-action suggestions inside task details
- Focus sessions for completing one task
- Smart and recurring reminders
- Google Calendar integration
- Task breakdown into short, approvable subtasks
- Google Maps links for tasks that include a destination
- Optional live web research with source citations
- User-created Intelligence agents for companies, markets, technology, and other research use cases

## Intelligence boundaries

Premium Intelligence is user-initiated and feature-flagged. Opening a task does not automatically trigger web research. Simple actions such as Focus, reminders, and Maps can run without an AI request. Live research returns public-source context and citations; it does not claim access to private roadmaps or confidential information. External actions remain user-controlled and require approval when they create or change data.

## Who it is for

- People who think out loud and need structure
- Founders, operators, students, and professionals managing ambiguous work
- Anyone who needs help deciding what to do next, not another static task list
- Users who want current research connected to a task or goal
